caption: The drawing depicts a tall, rectangular wooden clock with detailed decorative elements. The main structure is brown with a polished wood texture, accented by gold-colored vertical columns on each side. At the top of the clock, there is an ornate carved crest in a darker brownish-gold hue with scroll and leaf motifs. The clock face is situated in the upper section, surrounded by a light beige background with gold decorative corners. The face itself features black Arabic numerals, black hour and minute hands, a brass center, and a circular pattern within the dial. Below the clock face is a rectangular panel with a light marbled or frosted appearance. At the bottom section of the clock, a horizontal rectangular compartment houses an oval ceramic or porcelain inset decorated with a gold border, a purple diamond-shaped center, and surrounding blue and green leaf motifs. The clock stands on four rounded wooden feet. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white.
title: Shelf Clock
